user_query: trass stories database entries with the term avask uk and au

intent.goal: find stories database entries containing avask uk and au terms

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
u.page_id,
u.workspace,
u.database_name,
u.title,
u.created_time,
u.file_path,
u.file_size
FROM unified_content u
WHERE (
    u.database_name = 'stories'
    AND (
        LOWER(u.title) LIKE '%avask%'
        OR LOWER(u.title) LIKE '%uk%'
        OR LOWER(u.title) LIKE '%au%'
        OR LOWER(u.file_path) LIKE '%avask%'
        OR LOWER(u.file_path) LIKE '%uk%'
        OR LOWER(u.file_path) LIKE '%au%'
    )
)
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 5000;
